moves.Mirror Shot: 20% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.Misty Explosion: The user faints. Halves the target's Defense in damage calculation.
moves.Moonblast: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1 stage.
moves.Mud Bomb: 20% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.Night Daze: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.Octazooka: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.
moves.Rage Fist: Power does not increase when the user is hit.
moves.Rock Smash: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
moves.Self-Destruct: The user faints. Halves the target's Defense in damage calculation.
moves.Thief: Deals damage only; does not steal the target's held item.
moves.Thunder Wave: Paralyzes the target. Electric-type users' Thunder Wave never misses.
moves.Wild Charge: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.
